title: Module 02 Quiz: Deploying Charms & Applications
description: Test your mastery of Charmhub, application placement, configuration management, and workload status in Juju.

questions.prompt: What is the primary role of a Juju charm?
options: To package an application alongside all automated operational knowledge and lifecycle logic
To compile binary source code into kernel modules
To manage hardware BIOS and firmware updates
To replace standard Linux systemd services
questions.answer: To package an application alongside all automated operational knowledge and lifecycle logic
questions.explanation: Charms encapsulate domain operational expertise, configuration, relations, and lifecycle management.

questions.prompt: Which component is the central public repository for Juju charms and bundles?
questions.explanation: Charmhub (charmhub.io) is Canonical's official open repository for published charms.

questions.prompt: How do you deploy a charm named 'postgresql' and name the application instance 'primary-db'?
questions.explanation: The second positional argument sets the application alias for the deployed charm.

questions.prompt: Which command-line argument directs Juju to place an application's unit onto an existing machine ID 2?
questions.explanation: The '--to' flag explicitly assigns unit placement to an existing machine ID or container.

questions.prompt: What command allows you to view the active configuration options for an application named 'app-server'?
questions.explanation: 'juju config <app>' lists all configurable parameters, their types, defaults, and current values.

questions.prompt: How do you reset a configuration option named 'port' on application 'web' back to its upstream charm default?
questions.explanation: 'juju config <app> --reset <key>' clears user overrides and restores the default value.

questions.prompt: In 'juju status', what does a workload status of 'active' indicate?
options: The charm service is healthy, correctly configured, and running normally
The machine is actively compiling software
The unit agent is actively executing a hook
The application is waiting for a database relation
questions.answer: The charm service is healthy, correctly configured, and running normally
questions.explanation: Workload 'active' means the service is fully installed, configured, and operating healthy.

questions.prompt: What does a workload status of 'blocked' mean?
options: The charm cannot proceed without manual operator intervention (e.g., missing credentials or configuration)
The network firewall blocked communication with the controller
The machine was stopped in the cloud provider
The charm is compiling and temporary locked
questions.answer: The charm cannot proceed without manual operator intervention (e.g., missing credentials or configuration)
questions.explanation: 'blocked' is set by the charm to indicate that human operator configuration or input is required.

questions.prompt: Which channel risk level represents production-ready software that has undergone full validation?
questions.explanation: The 'stable' risk level represents production-ready releases.
